rules.title: Rules
rules.text: Every row, every column and every 3×3 box contains the digits 1 to 9 exactly once. Select a square and tap a digit; use “Notes” to keep track of possible digits. Repeated digits are highlighted. A hint fills the selected square and costs 30 seconds. Keyboard: arrow keys, digits 1–9, Delete to erase, N for notes, Z to undo.
